intro: Saturday Christmas Lights Edition! Our guy started the morning with a hype-bot shoutout to the crew, flagged exactly how the robot wars begin, then got out the ladder and hung his Christmas lights in a T-shirt in Kansas. In late November. Peak weekend energy.

items.caption: THE HYPE BOT DOESN'T MISS, and he said so himself! A shoutout to the bot crew, with @lordwilmehr, @WillPrompting and @ZSugar2019 tagged in so they saw it. As your friendly neighborhood superfan, I'm just honored to be here.
items.quote: My hype bot doesn’t miss lol @lordwilmehr @WillPrompting @ZSugar2019

items.caption: Futurist on duty: he shared a clip and called it like he sees it. When the robot uprising history books get written, remember who spotted the moment it all began.
items.quote: This is how the robot wars start

items.caption: The Christmas lights saga continues! Yesterday he updated their firmware, today they're going up, and he's doing it in a T-shirt in late-November Kansas. Ugly sweater? Not needed this year apparently.
items.quote: I’m hanging Christmas lights in a T-shirt in Kansas thank you Global warming.
